hero.subtext: Most users earn their first rupee within twenty-four hours. Here is precisely how it happens, step by step.

step1.title: Download & sign up
step1.description: Download the Funngro app on Android. Verify with OTP and add your UPI ID. That is all you need to start earning from real brand campaigns. Free forever.

step2.title: Pick a brand campaign
step2.description: Browse campaigns from India's biggest brands. Pick what excites you — influencer briefs, product sampling, referrals, or surveys. Every campaign shows the exact pay before you start.

step3.title: Do the work
step3.description: Complete the campaign on your schedule. Post on social media, share with friends, try the product, or fill the survey. Funngro validates your submission before crediting.

step4.title: Get paid in UPI
step4.description: Once approved, money hits your UPI in seconds. Zero fees. No minimum balance. First-time users typically see their first rupee within twenty-four hours.

step5.title: Grow your ladder
step5.description: Each campaign unlocks higher-paying opportunities. Level up from Starter to Grower to Builder. Top earners lead their own Clan and earn from their team's work too.

items.title: Participation-to-Execution
items.desc: Start simple with surveys and referrals. Progress to executing real brand projects independently.

items.title: Progressive Earning Model
items.desc: Level up from task-based pay to referrals, then to business revenue as you build trust.

items.title: Trust Before Influence
items.desc: Earn your reputation with consistent work. Trust unlocks access to premium brand campaigns.

items.title: Movement Up Value Chain
items.desc: Each stage moves you higher in the value chain — from consumer to promoter to creator to leader.

items.title: Capability-Linked Income
items.desc: Your earning ceiling rises with your skills. Funngro tracks every task to match higher-value work.

items.title: Own Your Micro-Business
items.desc: The final stage: build and lead your own team. Earn from your Clan's work while brands pay you directly.

That is precisely what Funngro sells. No bots. No inflated metrics. Only real, verified action from seventy lakh young Indians who genuinely engage.
